task: Owner decision 2026-11-08 on #585: refresh the Harbor trivy-db mirror automatically where the cluster has egress (airgap keeps the manual promote gate), and keep Harbor, the trivy-server PVC and the workstation bundle from growing without bound.

events.summary: Add a CronJob mirror refresh, its Harbor robot/retention/GC provisioning, two alerts and workstation-bundle pruning. Deliberately left alone: the manual fetch/promote/push flow and its approval gate (still the only path for airgap and provider kakao), trivy-checks (frozen upstream, manual push), trivy-operator values, Kyverno policies (security-system is already excluded from the image-signature, registry and latest-tag rules), the live cluster (read-only kubectl/port-forward and anonymous Harbor GETs only, nothing applied), Gitea, the promotion log (append-only on purpose) and .promoted-swap-tmp (can hold the only copy of a set).

Live read-only 2026-11-08: trivy-server metadata.json UpdatedAt 2026-11-06T01:07 NextUpdate 2026-11-07T01:07 (mirror stale); Harbor trivy-db/trivy-java-db each hold 3 artifacts (2 untagged, 139 MB and 995 MB) and project trivy-db has no retention_id; trivy-server PVC holds db/trivy.db 1.6G of 5G plus fanal.db 2 MiB with /tmp an empty emptyDir; kube-state-metrics exposes kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time.

D-SECDB-AUTO: skopeo CronJob every 6h, digest-pinned image, non-root, robot credential from Secret trivy-db-refresh, TLS verified with narwhal-ca-cert, current-mirror skip, size floor, post-copy digest check, approved_by=auto-refresh audit line; Application gated off for kakao and securityDbAutoRefresh.enabled=false. D-SECDB-AUTO-ROBOT/RETENTION: 08-5 creates the project-scoped robot, a keep-2 retention policy including untagged, and a GC schedule only when none exists. D-SECDB-AUTO-ALERT: TrivyDbRefreshFailed and TrivyDbRefreshStale. D-SECDB-BOUND: fetch prunes staged names that left the list. 08-6 distributes the CA to security-system. quay.io/skopeo/stable v1.22.2 added to images.txt, image-digests.tsv and VERSIONS.md (v1.22.3 was inside the 7-day cooling window).

events.scope: Static and behavioral, no cluster: R322 runs the CronJob script against a stub skopeo, the 08-5 Harbor block against a fake Harbor API (idempotent re-run, scoped robot, keep-2 retention, GC only when none), the fetch prune loop, helm template (vagrant renders, kakao and enabled=false do not) and promtool cases for both alerts; 30 mutations are rejected. NOT covered: a real CronJob run, the real Harbor 2.15.1 API (endpoints checked against the upstream v2.14.0 swagger), Kyverno admission, the image running as uid 10001, ArgoCD sync, Prometheus loading the rules.

events.summary: In the repository the mirror refresh, its credential provisioning, retention/GC, alerts and the storage-bound documentation are in place and pinned by R322. That the mirror actually refreshes and that Harbor retention and GC reclaim space on the live cluster is not demonstrated; it needs push-to-gitea, re-running 08-5 (robot Secret, retention, GC) and a first Job run.
Complete for the repository scope; not deployed, no live CronJob run, no Harbor mutation.
